_about: Outcomes a reviewer read from figures or tables, used when the paper text does not state the result. Settings listed under 'unstated' are dropped from the automatic extraction, with the reason.

arxiv:1509.03580.locator: Table 4: identified Lorenz coefficients at derivative-noise variance eta = 1
arxiv:1509.03580.note: Read by a reviewer from Table 4. The text adds that the form of the equations holds up to eta = 10.

arxiv:2009.08810.locator: Figure 14 bar labels: 8% is the most noise original SINDy handles on Lorenz
arxiv:2009.08810.note: Read by a reviewer from the Figure 14 image. 10% is the first level above the stated 8% limit; the paper does not list the tested levels, so 10% is an assumption.

unstated.threshold: lambda = 0.1 in Section 3.2 applies to modified SINDy; original SINDy used a threshold sweep with no stated selection rule
